voices.title: Crazy to think Max Muncy who was DFA by the Athletics is going to break the Dodgers ALL-TIME HR record. One of my favorite players ever.
reply_texts: Max Muncy is my favorite player too 🥹
And yet somehow Max Muncy still plays for the A's.

reply_texts: Looks much better than his prancing.
